3

Language Lab

Use a/an, be, he/she and his/her.

8-10 min
aa chef • a doctor
anan engineer • an architect
he / hisHe is a doctor. His workplace...
she / herShe is a chef. Her workplace...
Article rule
Use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound.
1. Marta is ___ teacher.
2. Omar is ___ engineer.
3. Leo is ___ doctor.
4. Ana is ___ accountant.
5. I ___ a student.
6. She ___ a chef.
7. Maya is a nurse. ___ works at a hospital.
8. Paul is a programmer. ___ works at a tech company.
9. Maya is a nurse. ___ workplace is a hospital.
10. Paul is a programmer. ___ workplace is a tech company.
11. What ___ her job?
12. I ___ an architect.

Jobs and workplaces

Choose one typical workplace for each job.

6-8 min
1. Doctor
2. Teacher
3. Chef
4. Manager
5. Engineer
6. Programmer
7. Receptionist
8. Bike Mechanic
Real-world note
These are typical examples, not fixed rules. A programmer can work from home; a chef can work in a hotel.
